ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in the Cartesian coordinate system, the graph of the linear function \(y=\frac{1}{2}x+1\) intersects the x-axis and y-axis at points A and B, respectively. A square ABCD is constructed in the second quadrant with AB as one of its sides. What are the coordinates of points C and D?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, let $CE\perp y$ axis, $DF\perp x$ axis,\\
$\therefore \angle CEB=\angle AFD=\angle AOB=90^\circ$.\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a square,\\
$\therefore BC=AB=AD$, $\angle DAB=\angle ABC=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle DAF+\angle BAO=90^\circ$, $\angle ABO+\angle CBE=90^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle DAF+\angle ADF=90^\circ$, $\angle BAO+\angle ABO=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAO=\angle ADF=\angle CBE$,\\
$\therefore \triangle BCE\cong \triangle DAF\cong \triangle ABO(AAS)$,\\
$\therefore BE=DF=OA=2$, $CE=AF=OB=1$,\\
$\therefore OE=OB+BE=3$, $OF=OA+AF=3$,\\
$\therefore$ The coordinates of point C are $\boxed{(-1, 3)}$, the coordinates of point D are $\boxed{(-3, 2)}$;

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached diagram, the coordinate axes are shown with O at the origin. The line has positive slope, crosses the x-axis at A to the left of the origin, and crosses the y-axis at B above the origin. The square ABCD is drawn on the upper-left side of side AB, lying in the second-quadrant direction; C is above-left of B and D is above-left of A. Reasoning: From the line y = (1/2)x + 1, the x-intercept A is found by setting y = 0: 0 = (1/2)x + 1, so x = -2, hence A = (-2, 0). The y-intercept B is found by setting x = 0: y = 1, hence B = (0, 1). The vector from A to B is v = B - A = (0 - (-2), 1 - 0) = (2, 1). Since the square is constructed on the second-quadrant/upper-left side of AB, the adjacent side vector is the counterclockwise 90-degree rotation of v, namely w = (-1, 2). Therefore C = B + w = (0, 1) + (-1, 2) = (-1, 3), and D = A + w = (-2, 0) + (-1, 2) = (-3, 2). Final answer: C = (-1, 3), D = (-3, 2).
